title: A Room Full of Monsters
tagline: the third boss - vectors of structs, changed in place
hints: Read three fields at once: `while (std::cin >> name)` then `if (name == "done") break;` then `std::cin >> hp >> atk;`. Build a Monster and push_back it.
`for (Monster& m : room)` gives you the REAL monsters. `for (Monster m : room)` gives you copies, and your damage vanishes - floor 10 again, in disguise.
Toughest = most hp. Track the index of the best so far, and only replace it when you find something STRICTLY greater, so ties keep the first one.
Sweep and survivor count are two separate passes. Do the whole sweep first, printing as you go, then walk the vector again and count the living.
The death line is two spaces, the name, then ` dies` - printed right after the hit that did it, inside the same loop pass.
